title: Asset domain schema and migrations
description: Drizzle schema + migrations for the SMB infrastructure domain
spec:
1. Define Drizzle tables for assets, asset_aliases, asset_hardware_profiles, asset_network_interfaces, asset_storage_allocations, asset_relationships, asset_services, service_catalog, service_dependencies, asset_ports, sites, network_zones, owners, vendors, asset_tags, imports, import_rows, asset_change_events.
2. Use snake_case DB names and camelCase TypeScript fields.
3. Include created/updated timestamps, actor IDs where appropriate, and soft-delete fields (is_deleted/deleted_at/deleted_by) where records may be hidden.
4. Add asset type enum covering all required asset types and relationship type enum covering all required relationship types.
5. Wire tables into backend/src/db/schema/index.ts.
6. Generate Drizzle migrations via db:generate.
7. Add PostgreSQL schema mirror if the template maintains schema-pg/.
8. Verify autoMigrate applies the new migrations on a fresh SQLite database.
9. Add seed data for sites, owners, and a starter service_catalog.
10. Run bun run check:schema-parity and confirm no drift.
11. Run bun run smoke:qc and confirm it passes.
